versions.subject: Merge PR #5479 from @swachchhanda000 - Webdav CVE-2025-33053 RCE vulnerability
versions.detection:
selection_src:
    SourceImage:
        - 'C:\Program Files\internet explorer\iediagcmd.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\CustomShellHost.exe'
selection_target_dir:
    - TargetImage|startswith: '\\\\'
    - TargetImage|contains: '\DavWWWRoot\'
selection_target_exe:
    TargetImage|endswith:
        - '\route.exe'
        - '\netsh.exe'
        - '\makecab.exe'
        - '\dxdiag.exe'
        - '\ipconfig.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: SourceImage IN ("C:\\Program Files\\internet explorer\\iediagcmd.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\CustomShellHost.exe") TargetImage IN ("\\\\*", "*\\DavWWWRoot\\*") TargetImage IN ("*\\route.exe", "*\\netsh.exe", "*\\makecab.exe", "*\\dxdiag.exe", "*\\ipconfig.exe", "*\\explorer.exe")
